name: Telemetry::publish

test_list.description: Before any publish, snapshot() returns an all-zero snapshot of the session (smoke: the /usage view has data to render).
publish() makes a new snapshot visible; an Arc taken earlier keeps its old content.
A SnapshotReader obtained before recording sees what the writer publishes later.
Four threads read snapshots continuously while the writer records and publishes; the writer finishes and every observed snapshot is internally consistent (monotonic request count).
A snapshot serialises to JSON and deserialises to an equal value.
insta fixture: a hand-built synthetic event stream (labelled synthetic, not recorded live) produces the expected snapshot text.

inputs.name: at
inputs.description: Publication time, supplied by the owner task (the crate has no clock).

output_description: Immutable snapshot swapped in atomically; readers never lock.
